notes: Ranch brand of a fifth-generation ranch family in the Gypsum Hills of south-central Kansas (cattle raised at Gypsum Hills Ranch; an earlier lead and press place the ranch near Lake City, but the site names no ranch town). City and address are the contact page's business address in Medicine Lodge, which is also its own USDA processing plant, Medicine Lodge Meat Co. Read homepage, our story, about, contact, Shipping and Returns policy, and the 1/2 steer deposit product page (WebFetch summaries only, so recheck the verbatim quote). The verbatim is the homepage page title; body text says 'We raise grass-fed Gypsum Hills Beef' and cattle are 'Nurtured exclusively on the rich grass'; steer deposit page says '100% grass-fed beef'. No grain mentioned anywhere. Shipping policy: 'we currently only accept orders placed in Kansas, Oklahoma and Missouri', UPS and USPS, ships Mon to Wed. Quarter, half and whole steer deposits; fractional shares delivered free to the Wichita metro, can ship for a fee, 5% discount for pickup at Medicine Lodge Meat Company. Site also has a vendor (wholesale) form.
